stages.name: Full-year PU Prime MT5 tick history
+$1-at-0.01 MT5 outcome atlas
stages.detail: Every tick labeled for a +$100 BTC move using executable bid/ask sides.
stages.finding: BUY ask→future bid; SELL bid→future ask; 900-second forward path.

stages.name: MT5 causal tick feature engine
stages.detail: 81 causal tick-level broker features built and regression tested.
stages.finding: Uses bid/ask microstructure, spread, velocity, range, efficiency, pressure and range position.

stages.name: Discovery threshold fitting
stages.detail: Thresholds fitted only on the 183-day Discovery period.
stages.finding: Untouched Confirmation/Hard/Holdout outcomes were not used for fitting.

stages.name: Full-year MT5 state matrix
stages.detail: 365/365 days binned with frozen MT5 thresholds.
stages.finding: This creates the searchable MT5 state infrastructure for backward winner mining.

stages.name: Backward mining of +$1 winners
stages.detail: Mine the causal MT5 tick path before profitable +$100 moves.
stages.finding: This is the next research stage after the state matrix finishes.

stages.name: MT5 precursor discovery
stages.detail: Find repeatable MT5-native winning precursor families.

stages.name: Exact MT5 broker replay
stages.detail: Replay frozen MT5 precursors with spread, bid/ask, one-position and LOSS_FIRST semantics.

stages.name: Binance strength cross-reference
stages.detail: Use Binance only after MT5 precursor rules are frozen.
stages.finding: Earlier single-condition experiment raised one MT5 setup from ~45.8% to 91.67%, but produced zero stable ≥98% rules.

stages.name: Combined high-precision union
stages.detail: Preserve ≥98% families and combine non-conflicting executable trades.

stages.name: Robustness / delays / friction
stages.detail: Re-test surviving combined rules under execution stress scenarios.

stages.name: Shadow / demo readiness
stages.detail: No promotion until all research and validation gates pass.

notes: Current active research mines MT5 tick outcomes first; Binance is confirmation only.
No live orders are sent by this research pipeline.
A displayed PENDING metric has not yet been scientifically measured for the current architecture.
